html:
G'oya

Natijada sotuvi bor juftliklar emas, barcha mumkin bo'lgan juftliklar bo'lishi kerak. Bunday "hamma kombinatsiyalar" ro'yxatini CROSS JOIN yasaydi: 2 do'kon va 3 mahsulotdan 6 juftlik. Keyin har bir juftlikka uning sotuvlarini LEFT JOIN bilan ulaymiz va yig'amiz.

Yechim

SELECT s.name AS store, p.name AS product,
       COALESCE(SUM(x.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN products p
LEFT JOIN sales x ON x.store_id = s.id AND x.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, p.id, p.name

LEFT JOIN sharti ikki qismli: sotuv aynan shu do'kon va aynan shu mahsulotga tegishli bo'lsin. Sotuvsiz juftlikda x.quantity NULL, SUM ham NULL qaytaradi va COALESCE uni 0 qiladi. Guruh id lar bo'yicha, nomlar faqat ko'rsatish uchun.

Namunada Chilonzorda non ikki marta sotilgan (10 va 5), natijada 15. Yunusobodda faqat choy sotilgan, u yerdagi non va sut 0 bilan chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

sales dan boshlash. Unda faqat sotuvi bor juftliklar chiqadi va nollar yo'qoladi: namunada 6 o'rniga 3 qator.

Noto'g'riSELECT s.name AS store, p.name AS product, SUM(x.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM sales x
JOIN stores s ON s.id = x.store_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = x.product_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, p.id, p.name

COALESCE siz sotuvsiz juftliklarda NULL chiqadi, shart esa 0 ni so'raydi.

GROUP BY s.name, p.name ham xato: nomi bir xil ikki do'kon bitta qatorga qo'shilib ketadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Sotuvlarni avval do'kon va mahsulot bo'yicha yig'ib, keyin ulash ham mumkin. Unda tashqi so'rovda GROUP BY kerak emas:

SELECT s.name AS store, p.name AS product, COALESCE(t.q, 0) AS total_quantity
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN products p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT store_id, product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY store_id, product_id
) t ON t.store_id = s.id AND t.product_id = p.id
